LBR.note: No rule or authority on AI harms stated.
AI is a training topic only; no government AI system stated.
No AI model, dataset or computing stated.
Targets youth, educators, entrepreneurs and community members; civil servants not named.

facts.fact: The Liberia Development Dashboard lists Cyber Liberia 2030, led by the Liberia Cyber Crime Prevention and Mitigation Agency, as a pipeline project to train at least 20,000 Liberians in digital literacy, cybersecurity and AI between October 2026 and October 2027.

systems.owner: Liberia Cyber Crime Prevention and Mitigation Agency

LBR.note: No consultation on a digital law or policy stated.
No school internet figure or compulsory curriculum stated; cybersecurity clubs in schools are only planned.
